contract: ActivitySaveCommand accepts CataloguedLocationSelection? and ActivityCreateReservationIntent? without a fabricated consumer ID.
ActivityCreateReservationIntent.toJson() encodes exactly first_occurrence, recurrence and conflict_justification. Once/weekly encoding preserves the existing reservation DTO conventions.
activityLocationCreateAvailable defaults false. Selection or orphan reservation cannot silently fall back to the old aggregate writer. The no-selection/no-reservation path is preserved.

One candidate RPC returns the aggregate, location ID and optional reservation; response validates envelope, error fields, IDs, positive safe version, draft status, replay flag and correlated reservation consumer/location/state.
